Your Job

Molex creates connections for life by enabling technologies that transform the future and improve lives. With presence in more than 40 countries, Molex offers a complete range of connectivity products, services and solutions for the data communications, medical, industrial, automotive and consumer electronics industries.

We are expanding our CAE team in our Transportation and Industrial Solutions Division. We are looking for a talented individual to join our team. In this role, the Senior Mechanical Simulation Engineer: Structural will drive and validate design features related to structural performance on automotive connector applications, using CAE methods and tools.


Our Team

The TSBU Predictive Engineering Team enables/delivers robust product design and virtual validation by developing and applying Product Digital Twin capabilities across core engineering functions. In this role, the engineer will support mechanical virtual validation using advanced FEA tools, working closely with product development teams to predict performance, identify risks early, and improve simulation-to-test correlation.


What You Will Do

  • Coordinate and provide mechanical engineering analysis support, predominately with FEA, on short fiber reinforced plastic & copper alloy-based component systems through Hyperworks and Abaqus tools.
  • Work on nonlinear Durability & Linear vibration simulations.
  • Participate in correlation of CAE simulations to real world performance and make recommendations to improve simulation accuracy as needed.
  • Develop scripts to automate CAE processes to improve efficiency.
  • Work on process automation tools (ISIGHT, Hyper study, Mode Frontier etc.) to automate CAE workflow & building regression models on nonlinear engineering applications to provide design solutions (Innovative/cost effective).
  • Communicate technical knowledge and experimental findings in both written and verbal formats to peers, management, and customers.
  • Attend training and conferences to stay current with latest developments.
  • Some travel, as necessary; may be required.


Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)

  • Masters / Bachelor's degree in engineering, Chemistry, Physics or Material Science
  • At least 5 years of experience with FEA applications
  • Experience with scripting, process automation tools (ISIGHT, Hyper study, Mode Frontier etc.) to automate CAE workflow & building regression models on nonlinear engineering applications
  • Experience with parametric CAD systems (UG NX, CATIA or SolidWorks, etc.)
  • Root cause and failure analysis aptitude


What Will Put You Ahead

  • PhD in Engineering, Physics, Material Science
  • 5+ years' experience with SIMULIA (ABAQUS, Isight) products
  • 5+ years' experience with Altair (Hyperworks, Simlab) family products
  • 3+ years' experience with CAE engineering user support & training
  • 3+ years' experience with CAE modeling applications in predicting nonlinear structural behavior on short fiber reinforced plastics & metals
  • 3+ years' experience with scripting & CAE process automation tools (ISIGHT, Hyper study, Mode Frontier etc.)
  • 2+ years' experience on using Machine learning/AI for building regression models on nonlinear engineering applications.
  • Experience in leading and mentoring a team.
  • Experience with analytical analysis packages (MATLAB, MATHEMATICA, etc.)


At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy.


Who We Are

As a Koch company, Molex is a leading supplier of connectors and interconnect components, driving innovation in electronics and supporting industries from automotive to health care and consumer to data communications. The thousands of innovators who work for Molex have made us a global electronics leader. Our experienced people, groundbreaking products and leading-edge technologies help us deliver a wider array of solutions to more markets than ever before.

At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.

Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results.
